spans.s: [ciya = iva, like, acc. to mss. at Mv 〔ii.158.7〕 (prose) karṣakā ciya, like peasants; Senart em. viya, prob. rightly. No ciya or cia is authenticated for iva; Sheth s.v. cia = iva is based on an erroneous statement in Woolnerʼs Introduction to Prakrit, Vocabulary, where cia should be equated with eva, not iva.]
